skill_name: Write a paragraph of at least 5 sentences about the invention of the telephone.
workflow: The telephone was invented in 1876 by Alexander Graham Bell, who initially called it the “electrical speech machine”. The telephone consists of a transmitter, which converts sound into electrical signals, and a receiver, which converts the signals into audible sound. At first, these devices were crude but eventually, they were made smaller and more efficient.
